sources.title: ML Kit GenAI Prompt API for Android
sources.notes: Beta API, custom text/multimodal prompts and structured output; no SLA or deprecation guarantee.

sources.title: Apple Foundation Models framework
sources.notes: Sessions, guided generation, tools, availability checks and prompt-version management; parts of the API are beta.

sources.title: Apple LanguageModelSession
sources.notes: Stateful transcript, prewarm, structured responses, tools and context-size errors; API documentation labels preliminary/beta surfaces.

sources.title: FunctionGemma model card
sources.notes: 270M function-calling base; current official Mobile Actions example reports 58% base, 85% fine-tuned and S25 Ultra CPU performance.

sources.title: Fine-tuning with FunctionGemma
sources.notes: Corroborates task-specific SFT and synthetic examples; explicitly requires Gemma terms acceptance and a model-access token.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.notes: Separate from Apache-2.0 runtime source code. Acceptance and commercial/legal applicability are Human-owned.
